codename: Dynamic Status Engine, API Key Rotation, Smart Routing & RAG Optimization
title: Dynamic Status Engine, API Key Rotation, Smart Routing & RAG Optimization
summary: This massive milestone transforms VISAR Edge's internal architecture, introducing a highly modular Status Bar engine for real-time telemetry, robust API key rotation, intelligent LLM routing, and significant vector database optimizations.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Deployed a modular Status Bar framework (StatusEngine) to display runtime telemetry via Qt Signals and dynamic upsert logic.
Introduced Task Widget Architecture featuring BasicTask, animated SpinnerTask, and QTimer-based auto-expiring progress alerts.
Integrated live CPU and RAM tracking directly into the Status Engine pipeline.
Implemented an API Key Rotator (Singleton) for thread-safe, round-robin load balancing with on-the-fly .env reloading.
Built an Intelligent Model Router to dynamically select optimal models based on prompt data and available keys.
Created a dedicated 'AI & LLM Settings' UI sector and integrated new SFX audio cues for system events.
Added a global error handler to catch system-wide exceptions and auto-force the UI into an error state.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Upgraded ChromaDB ingestion with Smart Batch Processing, using cached hashes to completely eliminate redundant processing.
Shifted Vector Store loading and indexing entirely to background threads, drastically reducing application startup time.
Connected Vector DB processing directly to the Status Engine for real-time UI broadcasting of loading progress.
Upgraded Local LLM pipelines to fully support conversation history and dynamic persona loading via utils/personas.py.
Upgraded the OTA update protocol to check versions directly against raw JSON files hosted on GitHub.
Implemented lazy-loading for sidebar icons and replaced legacy emojis with clean, sci-fi compliant icon labels.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Resolved INVALID_ARGUMENT errors for Gemma models by dynamically injecting system instructions directly into user messages.
Fixed RAG content injection structures to guarantee zero redundancy within LLM context windows.
Patched minor listening and idle state function triggers.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Cleaned up and removed redundant JSON prompt contents from the API payload pipeline.

requirements: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview / Groq / Local Models

notes: Version 1.4.0.0 fundamentally optimizes VISAR's backend stability and speed. The introduction of background threading for the Vector DB, combined with round-robin API load balancing, ensures uninterrupted intelligence routing. The new Status Engine provides deep transparency into system operations without cluttering the primary Neural Feed.
